correctness.rationale: The rotation-only source quotient is exactly cyclic triples of zero gaps. The marker-deletion outputs are unordered complementary pairs {x,s−x}; distinct positive gaps can be complementary only if the third gap is zero. The two nonidentity cyclic shifts in the comparison of (a−1,b,c) with (a,b−1,c) yield exactly a=b=c or a=b=c+1, including (1,1,0). Thus all deletion collisions are exhausted, and the two weight classes of outputs are disjoint. Anchoring at the sole zero gap gives s−1 ordered positive pairs, the repeated positive value ranges from 1 to floor((s−1)/2), and inclusion–exclusion on equalities of positive ordered triples gives the stated numerator for C_{s,6}, divided by their orbit size three. Burnside gives the stated total, including the periodic equal-gap orbit. s=0 and s=2 give the claimed exceptions; (1,2,s−3) witnesses B=6 for every s≥6. The mean defect numerator is 4C_{s,2}+3C_{s,3}+2C_{s,4}+C_{s,5}=2s+f_s+2+3e_s+z_s+h_s; the number outside the size-six class is s+f_s. These and N_s=s²/6+O(s) verify both asymptotics. RESULT.md lines 51–77 prove the full family; the reviewed verify.py is finite corroboration, not used as proof. The wording about labeled-word sampling should be read as a distinction between sampling conventions, not as saying they differ at every length: if 3 does not divide s, the label multiplicities are all equal.

value.rationale: As a mathematical result this is a complete infinite-family degree census for a natural sparse cyclic deletion channel: it separates period-driven and genuine cross-position collisions, identifies the length-nine onset of the generic degree, and quantifies ambiguity under uniform sampling. This is more informative than simply enumerating input necklaces. Mathematical usefulness does not make it a distinct contribution given the exact equivalent record.
